work.description: Entire refined LF10815–11158 and 20 literal LF of outside context fully read, using split('\n') only. Actual Leo XII attribution is positively consistent with the source protocol and closing. CCIX includes its own protocol LF10824, all eight paragraphs, every faculty/indulgence and complete 15 May 1827 dating LF11155–11158. Native leaf79 left LF10815–10865 continues right LF10868–10930; leaf80 left LF10942–11005 continues right LF11009–11071; leaf81 left LF11093–11158 completes perpetual indulgence and closing. The next CCX heading LF11083–11090 is displaced before this left-column tail in raw order, but its right-column coordinates separate it cleanly. Exact disjoint ranges exclude that neighboring heading and retain all CCIX body, including the split ne excepta quidem indulgentia / perpetua sentence. The specific LeoPPDecimusSecundus running header LF10936 lies inside the complete witness.  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
